scope: Owned mounted boat collision model against fixed-shape received boat/raft/minecart targets; original passenger exclusion lifetimes and nested-attachment fences.
publication: Public results and artifact hashes only. Original wire/NBT reports remain local. Native oracle fixture contains synthetic controlled terrain/tick/box inputs and outputs.
source_relationship: Compiled Rust, examples, Cargo and data are identical to qualification source; qualification adds only Python validation changes. Later evidence/docs commits do not change implementation.

native_oracle.registration: Original vehicle constructors, world registration and getBoundingBox; actual world lookup must find every declared rigid body. Legacy original despawn cleans scene entities; modern original entity-ticking chunks are awaited outside the server thread.
native_oracle.scope: Declared other vehicles are stationary inputs. Original server/physics classes, collision predicates and game geometry are unchanged; arbitrary pose/scale/interpolation and simultaneous other-entity ticks are not claimed.

version_only.legacy_nested_live: The original 1.16.1 server has no /ride command; nested attachment, transient receipt, sibling despawn and ID lifetime guards are tested with original packet codecs on both versions. Modern live /ride is a separately declared qualification.

diagnostics: Initial oracle setup was invalid: removed legacy actors remained in chunk queries and modern actors were outside entity-ticking sections. Corrected original registration/removal/ticking setup; no SDK expectation or trajectory tolerance weakened.
Initial live driver incorrectly requested SDK dismount after a retained unresolved refusal. The SDK correctly rejected replay; driver now verifies original forced exit and unchanged failure history.
Nested live driver response assertion was aligned to the original English /ride response (started riding). No SDK behavior changed for that correction.

Original /ride mount+dismount commands may coalesce before the native entity tracker sends any intermediate list. The driver now waits for the actual original attached SET_PASSENGERS before restoring the relation; unreceived intermediate server states are not counted as qualification.
The nested parent fixture is placed outside original minecart pickup distance so its automatic passenger pickup does not replace the declared explicit /ride trigger.
Final review added transient own-passenger parent fences, sibling edge preservation, fresh prediction seeds after nested receipts, and rejection of reusable passenger IDs without a new actual list.
remaining: General nonrigid entity pose/scale/interpolation and push simulation.
Other player postures, continuous creative/spectator flight, elytra and additional mount types remain separately scoped; non-survival held controls are tracked in #62.
The local collision model and complete dispatch are not received contact, server-current geometry, stop acknowledgement or per-frame execution acknowledgement.
